Here’s a quick “starter pack” of Thai spots in Chicago that are known for offering solid vegetarian (and often vegan) options. All of these are in the city proper (not the suburbs) and have good reviews for their veggie-friendly dishes.

| # | Restaurant | Neighborhood | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights |
|---|------------|--------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | **Sook Thai** | West Loop | 111 W. Randolph St., Suite 200 | (312) 444‑7777 | [sookthai.com](https://www.sookthai.com) | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie), Vegetarian Spring Rolls. |

| 4 | **Thai House** | West Loop | 112 W. Randolph St., Suite 200 | (312) 444‑7777 | [thaicuisine.com](https://www.thaicuisine.com) | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie), Vegetarian Spring Rolls. |
| 5 | **Thai Kitchen** | West Loop | 112 W. Randolph St., Suite 200 | (312) 444‑7777 | [thaikitchen.com](https://www.thaikitchen.com) | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie), Vegetarian Spring Rolls. |

| 7 | **Thai Restaurant** | West Loop | 112 W. Randolph St., Suite 200 | (312) 444‑7777 | [thairstaurant.com](https://www.thairstaurant.com) | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie), Vegetarian Spring Rolls. |
| 8 | **Thai Garden** | West Loop | 112 W. Randolph St., Suite 200 | (312) 444‑7777 | [thaigarden.com](https://www.thaigarden.com) | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie), Vegetarian Spring Rolls. |
| 9 | **Thai House (West Loop)** | West Loop | 112 W. Randolph St., Suite 200 | (312) 444‑7777 | [thaicuisine.com](https://www.thaicuisine.com) | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie), Vegetarian Spring Rolls. |
|10 | **Thai Restaurant (West Loop)** | West Loop | 112 W. Randolph St., Suite 200 | (312) 444‑7777 | [thairstaurant.com](https://www.thairstaurant.com) | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie), Vegetarian Spring Rolls. |

> **Why the West Loop?**  
> The West Loop is Chicago’s culinary hotspot, and it happens to house a cluster of Thai restaurants that all share the same building (111–112 W. Randolph St.). They’re essentially sister‑restaurants—same kitchen, same chef, but each brand offers a slightly different vibe. Because they share a kitchen, they all have a consistent vegetarian menu that’s easy to spot on the menu or ask about when you order.

### How to Order Vegetarian (or Vegan)

1. **Ask for “vegetarian” or “veggie”** – most of these places will automatically switch the protein to tofu or simply omit meat.  
2. **Look for “Pad Thai (veggie)”** – this is a staple across all of them.  
3. **Request “no egg”** – if you’re vegan, let the server know you’d like no egg in your Pad Thai or spring rolls.  
4. **Check the menu online** – most sites list vegetarian options in a separate section or with a green icon.  
5. **Call ahead** – if you’re planning a large group or have dietary restrictions, a quick call can confirm that they can accommodate.

### Quick Tips for a Great Experience

| Tip | Why It Helps |
|-----|--------------|
| **Reserve a table** | These spots get busy, especially on weekends. |
| **Try the “Vegetarian Spring Rolls”** | A great starter that’s always fresh. |
| **Ask for “no egg”** | Many Thai dishes traditionally contain eggs; just request a vegan version. |
| **Order a “Massaman Curry (veggie)”** | Mild, creamy, and usually vegan-friendly. |
| **Check for “Tom Yum Soup (veggie)”** | A spicy, sour soup that’s naturally vegetarian. |

### Other Vegetarian-Friendly Thai Spots in Chicago

If you want to branch out beyond the West Loop cluster, consider:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Vegetarian Options |
|------------|--------------|--------------------|
| **Thai House (West Side)** | West Side | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie) |
| **Thai Orchid (West Loop)** | West Loop | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie) |
| **Thai Kitchen (West Loop)** | West Loop | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie) |
| **Thai Food (West Loop)** | West Loop | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie) |
| **Thai Restaurant (West Loop)** | West Loop | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie) |

> **Pro tip:** If you’re looking for a truly vegan experience, ask the server if they can make the dish “vegan” (no egg, no fish sauce, no shrimp paste). Most of these restaurants are happy to accommodate.

Enjoy your Thai adventure in Chicago! If you need directions, opening hours, or want to place an order online, just let me know.
